description: Publishes a post to Threads now (publish_now:true) or at publish_at (ISO 8601 with offset). Takes text, one public https image (media_urls with 1 url), a carousel (2 to 10 urls) or a video_url. Text over 500 characters is split into a thread. Publishing now or within 30 minutes uses the publish-now permission; a post 30 minutes or more ahead uses the schedule permission. Either may wait for the owner's confirmation when that permission is set to ask on this connection. publish_at takes any offset and comes back in UTC (Z); a publish_at more than 60 seconds in the past returns 400 publish_at_in_past with server_now. The same account needs at least 10 minutes between scheduled posts: a closer publish_at returns 400 schedule_too_dense with nearest_publish_at. idempotency_key makes a retried request return the first result instead of posting twice. Applies when the user has final text and wants it on Threads.

media_urls.description: Public https image URLs (1 = image, 2-10 = carousel)

name: publish
title: Publish or schedule a post
